title: sarco: sarcopenia analysis of trunk CT (CIRCUS CAD plug-in)
description: Automatic L1/L3 localisation, skeletal muscle segmentation, sarcopenia measures (SMA, MSMD, VAT, SAT), contrast-phase estimation with conversion to non-contrast equivalent values, and age / height / weight estimation from trunk CT. Source code and trained model weights. For research use only.
